blurb: Atlantic National Golf Club offers a public golf course with clean greens and a layout suitable for skilled and casual players. The facility includes a driving range with small, medium, and large bucket options, a grass practice tee, chipping area, and two practice putting greens. They provide rental Titleist golf clubs and offer summer memberships with discounted greens fees and range balls.
